neumann_bc.description: Neumann ghost-cell prescription for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (ESS §9.2 / §9.4). The `value` is the outward normal derivative du/dn at the boundary; using a centered-difference approximation across the boundary face: (u[0] - u_ghost) / h = -value, giving u_ghost = u[0] + h * value. Pattern matches the synthetic `bc` node (§9.2) with `$side` bound to the boundary side (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, …) and `$h` bound to the grid spacing for that side's axis (e.g. dx for xmin/xmax, dy for ymin/ymax) via ESS bind_side_spacing guard; ESS kind/side pattern matching and bind_side_spacing wire this when available. `produces` declares the ghost variable per §9.4. Analytic check: (u[0] - u_ghost) / h = (u[0] - (u[0] + h*value)) / h = -value = du/dn.
